newsitem.title: UK: Stagecoach rolls ahead on profit hopes.
newsitem.headline: Stagecoach rolls ahead on profit hopes.

text.p: Shares in British rail and bus operator Stagecoach Holdings Plc rose on Monday ahead of full-year results on Tuesday.
Stagecoach shares climbed 13-1/2 pence to 733-1/2 in a generally weak market.
Traders said buyers were emerging for the shares ahead of results, which are expected to show profits more than doubled in the year to April.
According to Edinburgh Financial Publishing, analysts' median expectations are for pre-tax profits of 98.9 million stg, a jump of 127 percent from 43.6 million a year earlier.
Sales are expected to be ahead by a similar amount, reaching around 1.144 billion stg, partly reflecting Stagecoach's acquisition of privatised rail operator South West Trains.
